description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class 'Topic' within the OpenCart e-commerce framework. The class handles rendering a list of topics with associated articles, constructing URLs for each topic, and loading relevant models and language resources.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: A controller class for managing and displaying topics and their articles within an OpenCart module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads topics, constructs URLs, and renders the topic view. It handles request parameters and fetches data from 'cms/topic' and 'cms/article' models.
